family.description: This entry represents the C-terminal domain of SpoIID-like amidase enhancer proteins. It follows the SpoIID/LytB domain ([pfam:PF08486]) which is involved in peptidoglycan degradation. In Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803, the protein Slr0191 is annotated as a cell wall hydrolase and has been localised to the thylakoid membrane and periplasm. In Fibrobacter succinogenes, the homologue Fisuc_2398 shows increased expression in the presence of cellulose. The family is found in Cyanobacteriota, Bacillota and Bacteroidota. The specific function of this C-terminal domain remains to be determined.
family.name: Domain of unknown function (DUF8618)
